relation: definitional equality: Extremal D2chr's bfold_colouring and Chromatic X130's x130_bfold_colouring (the same body up to the binder annotation v : G, both unchanged since authoring) are GTBase.bfold_colourings.bfold_colouring b f: every vertex gets a b-element subset of the supplied palette 'I_a and adjacent vertices get disjoint subsets, with no guard (b = 0 and an empty vertex type allowed). The consumer chains stay distinct and are not migrated: X130's x130_frac_chi_le is an existential cross-multiplied natural bound (exists a b f, 0 < b, an (a:b)-colouring and a * q <= p * b; vacuous in the bound for q = 0, every row supplying q > 0) and D2chr's is_fractional_chromatic is an attained rational minimum over colourings with 0 < b.
summary: bfold-colouring, one family over the new focused module GTBase.bfold_colourings (no conjecture import, no base re-export): the (a:b)-fold colouring bfold_colouring b f of a supplied map f : G -> {set 'I_a}, the shared body of two local sources in two area packages (Chromatic X130, Extremal D2chr).

Its exact contract, corners included: #|f v| = b for every vertex and disjoint sets on adjacent vertices; b = 0 is allowed (the constant empty map, bfold_colouring0), an empty vertex type makes every map a colouring (bfold_colouring_empty), a vertex forces b <= a (bfold_colouring_le), an edge forces 2 * b <= a (bfold_colouring_edge); bfold_colouringP is the finite Boolean form. No positivity, no connectedness, no ratio.

Kept distinct and not migrated: X130's x130_frac_chi_le (a bound, not a minimum) and D2chr's is_fractional_chromatic (an attained rational minimum); both are frozen here as chain members over the frozen sources. The Hadwiger vocabulary of D2chr is outside this family and applied live.

Rows: X130, X131 (its literal duplicate), X149, X173, X204, X218 (the K_r-free degenerate row) and D2chr's fractional Hadwiger row, every guard and quantifier in place. X204Original composes B15's frozen cycle-length exclusion (Chromatic.migration.cycle_lengths) with this family's frozen chain.

Later-family note (2026-10-08, fractional-chromatic): D2chr's attained rational minimum is_fractional_chromatic, which this family froze as a chain member and listed as an unchanged distinct variant, is migrated by the later family fractional-chromatic (canonical Extremal.foundations.fractional_colouring.is_fractional_chromatic, separately certified in extremal-graph-theory/theories/migration/fractional_chromatic.v). It is therefore dropped from this family's unchanged distinct variants, as A11/A12/A13 did for A14 (LIBRARY_MIGRATION_A14.md). This family did not migrate that contract: its frozen chain Legacy.is_fractional_chromatic over Legacy.bfold_colouring, its whole-row certificate and its X204/D2chr Originals are unchanged and kernel-checked. The distinctions stay: the b-fold colouring (this family), the attained rational minimum chi_f with 0 < b (fractional-chromatic), and X130's existential cross-multiplied bound x130_frac_chi_le (still distinct here).
